sentiment.rationale: Full-year comparable EPS guidance was raised from 7%-8% to 8%-9% versus $3 in 2025, explicitly attributed to a lower effective tax rate (19.9% vs. prior estimate). Organic revenue guidance was reaffirmed at 4%-5%. The guidance raise is modest and partly mechanical (tax-driven), not a broad organic improvement. Management language is confident but acknowledges ongoing risks (geopolitical tensions, commodity pressures). The score is mildly positive due to the guidance raise, but tempered by the attribution to tax rate and reaffirmed revenue outlook.

summary.revenue: Organic revenue growth of 10% in Q1 2026, attributed to 3% unit case growth and positive pricing, partially offset by mix headwinds.
summary.eps: Comparable EPS of $0.86, up 18% year-over-year, benefiting from a 3% currency tailwind and higher equity income.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2026: organic revenue growth expected in the 4%-5% range; comparable currency-neutral EPS growth (ex-acquisitions and divestitures) of 6%-7%; comparable EPS growth now guided to 8%-9% versus $3 in 2025, up from prior 7%-8% estimate due to a reduced effective tax rate of 19.9%.
summary.margin: Comparable gross margin declined approximately 30 basis points due to commodity pressures in tea and coffee and inventory timing. Comparable operating margin expanded approximately 70 basis points, as operating expense efficiencies offset the gross margin decline.
key_risks: Comparable gross margin declined ~30 bps due to commodity pressures in tea and coffee and inventory timing; these cost headwinds expected to persist to some extent through the year.
Uncertainty stemming from geopolitical tensions may cause the outlook to change.
March volumes in Eurasia and Middle East declined after the onset of regional conflict.
Divestitures (including pending Coca-Cola Beverages Africa sale) expected to create a 4-point headwind to comparable net revenues and a 1-point headwind to comparable EPS.
Calendar shift: Q4 will have 6 fewer days compared to Q4 2025.
Mexico facing headwinds from implementation of a sugar tax.
key_opportunities: System added more than 600,000 outlets and placed over 340,000 units of cold drink equipment, growing points of interruption and visible inventory share by double digits.
Coca-Cola Zero-Zero relaunch in Europe with strong trial and repeat rates.
Global Sprite and Fuze Tea innovations contributed to double-digit volume growth for Fuze Tea.
FIFA World Cup activations expected to drive volume and engagement.
Pending sale of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa expected to create opportunity for more margin expansion in the latter half of 2026.
Expansion of rural distribution in India and localized innovation in China.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management states 'We are off to a good start this year' and 'I'm confident we are well positioned to deliver on our updated 2026 guidance,' reflecting a confident tone despite acknowledged risks.
